title: 第16章 不速之客
novel_title: 全民武道：女配小弟他无敌了！
content_zh:
安槐周一到校的时候，三班教室门口围了一圈人。

    说围不太准确，更像是被堵住了。一个穿着二年级校服的男生杵在门口，膀大腰圆，胳膊上的肌肉把校服撑得紧绑绑的，方脸上写满了三个字：不好惹。

    苏念念叉着腰站在他面前，一米六出头的身板堵在教室门口，像一只炸了毛的猫。

    “你到底走不走？这是我们班的教室，你一个二年级的跑来干什么？”

    方脸男生往下看了她一眼，表情像在看一个不知天高地厚的小朋友。

    “我说了，找安槐，跟你没关系。”

    “安槐是我小弟，跟他有关系的事就跟我有关系，你哪个班的？叫什么？”

    “二年一班，钟毅。”

    这个名字一报出来，围观的人群里有几个倒吸了口凉气。

    “去年全年级实战第一的那个钟毅？”

    “淬体七重的钟毅？”

    七重，教室门口的气氛瞬间变了味。

    一年级最高才五重，也就安槐一个人，七重和五重之间差了两个小境界，按照常理来说根本不是一个量级。

    苏念念皱了皱鼻子，但脚步没让半分。

    安槐从人群后面不紧不慢地走过来，语气温和。

    “这位学长，找我什么事？”

    钟毅的目光越过苏念念落在安槐身上，上下打量了一遍，眼里闪过一丝不屑。

    “你就是安槐？全年级摸底第一那个？”

    “是我。”

    “听说你入学前就到了淬体五重，用的还是联邦基础法？”

    “对。”

    钟毅嗤笑了一声。“基础法修到五重，要么是天才，要么是吹牛，放学后演武场，敢不敢来？”

    教室门口安静了一瞬。

    安槐歪了歪头：“学长专程跑来一年级的教室堵门口，就为了约架？”

    “叫交流。”

    “堵人家门口的交流，在联邦通识课里有个专门的名词，叫寻衅滋事。”

    钟毅脸色沉了一下。“你这嘴挺利索的。”

    “学长过奖。”安槐笑了笑，语气平淡得像在聊天气，“不过我下午有课，演武场去不了，学长要是非要交流的话，现在也行。”

    这话一出，围观人群炸了锅。
content_en:
When An Huai arrived at school on Monday, a circle of people gathered at the door of Class 3 classroom.

It's not accurate to say circumference, it's more like being blocked.A boy wearing a second-grade school uniform stood at the door. He was tall and round, and the muscles in his arms stretched the uniform tightly. Three words were written all over his square face: Not to be trifled with.

Su Niannian stood in front of him with her arms akimbo, her body of just over 16 meters tall blocking the door of the classroom, like a cat with exploded fur.

"Are you leaving or not? This is our classroom. What are you doing here, a second grader?"

The square-faced boy glanced down at her, with an expression like he was looking at a child who didn't know what the world was like.

"I said, looking for An Huai has nothing to do with you."

"An Huai is my younger brother. Whatever has to do with him has to do with me. Which class are you in? What's your name?"

"Class 2, Class 1, Zhong Yi."

As soon as the name was announced, several people in the crowd gasped.

"The Zhong Yi who ranked first in actual combat in the entire grade last year?"

"Zhong Yi from the seventh level of body tempering?"

Qizhong, the atmosphere at the classroom door suddenly changed.

The highest level in the first grade is only the fifth level, and An Huai is the only one. There is two small realms between the seventh level and the fifth level. According to common sense, they are not the same magnitude at all.

Su Niannian wrinkled her nose, but didn't move even an inch.

An Huai walked slowly from behind the crowd with a gentle tone.

"What does this senior want from me?"

Zhong Yi looked past Su Niannian and landed on An Huai. He looked up and down with a trace of disdain in his eyes.

"Are you An Huai? The one who is the best in the whole grade?"

"It's me."

"I heard that you reached the fifth level of body tempering before entering school, and you still used the federal basic law?"

"Yes."

Zhong Yi sneered."If you have practiced basic law to the fifth level, you are either a genius or a braggart. Do you dare to come to the martial arts field after school?"

There was silence at the door of the classroom for a moment.

An Huai tilted his head: "Senior came all the way to the first-grade classroom to block the entrance, just to have a fight?"

"It's called communication."

"There is a special term in federal general education courses for blocking communication at someone's door, which is called picking quarrels and provoking trouble."

Zhong Yi's face darkened."You have a very sharp tongue."

"Thank you, senior." An Huai smiled, his tone as calm as if he was chatting about his temper, "But I have classes in the afternoon and can't go to the martial arts field. If senior, I have to communicate, I can do it now."

As soon as these words came out, the crowd exploded.
